title: Direct Deposit Uplift on Credits Given on Filing — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Rate Note
content:
**Rate note.** This note covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. For the credit given on filing on an incorrect-amount dispute of a single-use virtual card purchase, the deposit uplift is read from the direct deposits into the linked Pocketwire Personal Account over the three months up to the filing date.

- **At least 4000.00:** the deposit uplift is 10.00.
- **At least 300.00, but less than 4000.00:** the deposit uplift is 5.00.
- **Less than 300.00:** the deposit uplift is 0.00.

The 300.00 edge is the card tier's direct-deposit threshold, which is 300.00 on every tier. Only direct deposits into the linked personal account count, totalled from the ledger of the Pocketwire Personal Account over the three months up to the filing date.

### Edges (hypothetical three-month totals)

| Direct deposits, three months up to the filing date | Deposit uplift |
|---|---|
| 4000.00 | 10.00 |
| 3999.99 | 5.00 |
| 300.00 | 5.00 |
| 299.99 | 0.00 |
| none | 0.00 |

*Hypothetical.* Three monthly paychecks of 1400.00 were deposited directly, totalling 4200.00. That is at least 4000.00, so the deposit uplift is 10.00.
